name: hud_sensor_tracker_load_mission_map_and_sfx
description: Formats the mission map path, loads it, resolves map overlay sound samples, and returns the map-load result.
known_limits: No isolated VC COFF byte comparison is recorded; tier S verification is deferred to the coherent HudSensorTracker/map.cpp source-cluster pass.
Sound lookup is validated through the reimplemented zSnd sample-set registry rather than a real DirectSound/A3D provider.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly for 0x417260 validates the .\maps\m%d.zmap path format, LoadMapFromPath delegation, and lookups of snd_mapOn, snd_mapOff, and snd_mapClick; the native smoke covers path formatting, map load, and sample pointer resolution.
